[SWS_EM_01402]
In safety related systems the system designer has to use
Non-reporting Process
functionality with care. Such
processes
will probably not provide safety critical func-
tionality and will not be monitored by
Platform Health Management
but still they
might influence other safety related
processes
and therefore can introduce a safety
risk. To isolate
Non-reporting Processes
from safety critical parts
Resource-
Group
can be used (see Section 7.7).
An attempt to report
Execution State
by a
Non-reporting Process
is considered
an error by
Execution Management
.
